provenance.what: A declared demo tariff set for the six retail plan names that appear in the Salesforce org (Everyday Saver, Standard Flexi, Time-of-Use Plus, Solar Saver, Assisted Essentials, Hardship Saver).
provenance.isNot: NOT a retailer's live pricing. These rates were authored for this deployment. They are not quoted, not sourced from a Victorian Default Offer determination, not from the Victorian Energy Compare feed, and not from any retailer price fact sheet.
provenance.useConstraint: Any saving computed from this table is a MODELLED estimate. It may be used to prioritise a best-offer review; it must not be presented to a customer as a quoted offer, and it is not evidence that a cl 132C best-offer check was performed against real market pricing.
provenance.author: Vocare decision layer (demo dataset)
provenance.replaceWith: A live retailer/VEC pricing integration. When one exists, register it as a separate PRICING_PROVIDER and retire this table.

assumptions.flatRateEquivalent: Time-of-Use Plus is modelled at a single blended c/kWh. Without interval data we cannot split peak/shoulder/off-peak, so its rate is a flat-rate equivalent and a customer with an unusual load shape will be mispriced.

eligibility.note: Modelled as a flat-rate equivalent; see assumptions.flatRateEquivalent.
